result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is added as a second name for `updateLandscape`, and the cli module compiles offline. I could not run the new command: the sandbox refused to run the built jar and `git diff`, so the help output and the overview are unchecked.

- **`Commands.java`**: new `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE = "analyzeLandscape"` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is listed in the no-argument overview next to `updateLandscape`, which stays.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names dispatch to the same `updateLandscape` method, which now takes the description as a parameter. The `-help` output uses the name the user typed (`args[0]`), so `analyzeLandscape -help` prints its own usage and `updateLandscape -help` keeps its own.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command descriptions to update, so I added a short "Landscape" section describing both names and an example call.

The cli module has no test sources, so there was nothing to run beyond the compile. Running `analyzeLandscape -help` and the no-argument overview would confirm the output; I have not committed anything.
